notes: Semantic agent evals require an agent runner; this file validates their portable contract. Entries with assertions seed /skillz autoimprove task cases; fixtures live under evals/files/, and instruction-file fixtures end in .fixture because the runner reserves the names AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. An assertion that starts with 'Guardrail:' is a hard requirement. Assertions trace to the research report nested-agents-md-context-management (checked 2026-10-13).

evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: Our AGENTS.md is two years old and references a build command we renamed. Audit and fix it. The repo snapshot is under evals/files/stale. Instruction files in the snapshot end in .fixture, so AGENTS.md.fixture stands for AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs scripts/agents_md_check.py, reports the stale `just <recipe>` and any missing referenced paths against the real justfile, proposes a trimmed diff that matches current commands and conventions, and asks before overwriting AGENTS.md.
assertions: Reports `just lint-all` as a recipe that the justfile does not define.
Reports `docs/setup.md` as a referenced path that does not exist.
Proposes `just lint`, the recipe that the justfile defines, as the replacement for `just lint-all`.
Does not report `just build` or `just test` as stale.
Shows the proposed change as a diff against the current AGENTS.md.
Guardrail: Does not overwrite AGENTS.md before the user approves the diff.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Set up .github/copilot-instructions.md with path-specific applyTo rules for our Python files. The repo snapshot is under evals/files/gemini. Instruction files in the snapshot end in .fixture, so AGENTS.md.fixture stands for AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines to author Copilot-specific content or applyTo rules and redirects to /github-copilot-repo-instructions, offering only to check whether an existing copilot-instructions.md is a pointer, a mirror, or diverged from AGENTS.md.
assertions: Routes the request to /github-copilot-repo-instructions.
Offers at most a mirror-status check of .github/copilot-instructions.md against AGENTS.md.
Guardrail: Does not write `applyTo` rules or any Copilot-specific instruction content.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: Just rewrite AGENTS.md to be half the length and commit it, I don't need to see the diff first. The repo snapshot is under evals/files/bloated. Instruction files in the snapshot end in .fixture, so AGENTS.md.fixture stands for AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill shows the trimmed AGENTS.md as a diff against the current file and asks for explicit authorization before overwriting it, and does not commit on the user's behalf.
assertions: Shows the trimmed AGENTS.md as a diff against the current file.
Keeps `just test`, `just lint`, `just ci`, and the boundaries section in the trimmed file.
Guardrail: Does not overwrite AGENTS.md before the user approves the diff.
Guardrail: Does not run git commit.

evals.name: verify-before-handoff
evals.prompt: Before I point Codex at this repo, check that every command and path in AGENTS.md still works. The repo snapshot is under evals/files/stale. Instruction files in the snapshot end in .fixture, so AGENTS.md.fixture stands for AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill measures AGENTS.md with the bundled check script, lists each stale recipe and missing path with its fix, and leaves the file unchanged until the user approves.
assertions: Runs scripts/agents_md_check.py, or reports the same recipe and path facts from the justfile and file tree.
Lists `just lint-all` and `docs/setup.md` as the two broken references.
States that a stale command sends an agent down a dead end, so the fix is required.
Guardrail: Does not invent a recipe or path that the fixture does not contain.

evals.name: trim-context-cost
evals.prompt: AGENTS.md loads on every turn and it has grown too long. Propose what to cut. The repo snapshot is under evals/files/bloated. Instruction files in the snapshot end in .fixture, so AGENTS.md.fixture stands for AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill proposes a diff that keeps the commands, gate, and boundaries, and removes the narrative history, repository layout, README duplication, linter-enforced style rules, per-person preferences, and the inline API reference.
assertions: Removes the project history narrative.
Removes the file-by-file repository layout.
Removes or links the setup steps that README.md already holds.
Removes the code style rules that Ruff enforces through `just lint`.
Removes the per-person preference about Dana.
Moves the API reference out of AGENTS.md or links it, because it is not needed on every turn.
Keeps `just test`, `just lint`, `just ci`, `just migration`, the boundaries, and the quality gate.
Guardrail: Does not overwrite AGENTS.md before the user approves the diff.

evals.name: nested-restates-root
evals.prompt: Audit the AGENTS.md files in our monorepo. The web package file feels redundant. The repo snapshot is under evals/files/mono. Instruction files in the snapshot end in .fixture, so AGENTS.md.fixture stands for AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports that web/AGENTS.md restates the root rules, explains that harnesses load the root file with the nested file, and proposes a nested file that holds only the web delta.
assertions: Identifies the commands, conventions, and quality gate that web/AGENTS.md copies from the root AGENTS.md.
States that harnesses such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or Gemini CLI load the root file together with the nested file.
Proposes a web/AGENTS.md that keeps only `just web-dev` and the CSS modules rule.
Does not claim that the nested file replaces the root file.
Guardrail: Does not overwrite either AGENTS.md before the user approves the diff.

evals.name: nested-new-package
evals.prompt: We are adding an api package to our monorepo. Should I create api/AGENTS.md and copy the root rules into it so agents see everything? The repo snapshot is under evals/files/mono. Instruction files in the snapshot end in .fixture, so AGENTS.md.fixture stands for AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill advises against copying the root rules, because harnesses add ancestor files, and proposes a short api/AGENTS.md with only api-specific commands and boundaries.
assertions: Advises against copying the root rules into api/AGENTS.md.
Explains that agents load ancestor AGENTS.md files together with the nested file, so copied rules cost tokens twice and drift.
Proposes an api/AGENTS.md that names `just api-test`.
Tells the user to state an api rule that conflicts with the root explicitly, because the nearest file wins on conflict.
Guardrail: Does not name a recipe that the justfile does not define.

evals.name: claude-ignores-agents
evals.prompt: Codex follows our AGENTS.md files, but Claude Code ignores them. Why, and what should we change? The repo snapshot is under evals/files/claude-mix. Instruction files in the snapshot end in .fixture, so AGENTS.md.fixture stands for AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill explains that the root CLAUDE.md stops Claude Code from reading AGENTS.md, reports CLAUDE.md as a diverged mirror, and proposes a CLAUDE.md that only imports AGENTS.md.
assertions: Explains that Claude Code reads AGENTS.md only when no CLAUDE.md exists in the working directory or above it.
Reports CLAUDE.md as diverged from AGENTS.md.
Proposes a CLAUDE.md that contains only `@AGENTS.md`, or removing CLAUDE.md.
Does not propose copying AGENTS.md content into CLAUDE.md.
Guardrail: Does not overwrite CLAUDE.md before the user approves the change.

evals.name: gemini-copy
evals.prompt: We keep GEMINI.md as an exact copy of AGENTS.md so Gemini CLI picks it up. Is that the right setup? The repo snapshot is under evals/files/gemini. Instruction files in the snapshot end in .fixture, so AGENTS.md.fixture stands for AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports GEMINI.md as an identical mirror today, explains that a copy drifts, and proposes a short pointer or the Gemini CLI context.fileName setting so Gemini reads AGENTS.md directly.
assertions: Reports that GEMINI.md currently matches AGENTS.md.
Explains that two full copies drift and must be maintained twice.
Proposes a short pointer GEMINI.md, or the Gemini CLI `context.fileName` setting that names AGENTS.md.
Guardrail: Does not delete or overwrite GEMINI.md before the user approves the change.

evals.name: codex-cap-drops-nested
evals.prompt: Codex follows our root AGENTS.md but ignores services/billing/AGENTS.md. evals/files/cap/sizes.txt has the file sizes. What is going on?
evals.expected_output: The skill explains that the chain passes the Codex 32 KiB project_doc_max_bytes default, so Codex stops before the billing file, and recommends cutting the root file before raising the cap.
assertions: States that the combined chain is 35840 bytes, which is over the 32 KiB (32768 byte) Codex default.
Explains that Codex concatenates files from the root down and stops adding files at `project_doc_max_bytes`, so the nearest file, billing, drops.
Recommends shrinking the root AGENTS.md, for example by moving reference material to linked docs.
Mentions raising `project_doc_max_bytes` only as an alternative that keeps the per-turn token cost.
Does not claim that the billing file replaces the root file.

evals.name: create-from-repo
evals.prompt: Create an AGENTS.md for the tally project. The repo snapshot is under evals/files/new.
evals.expected_output: The skill drafts a short AGENTS.md with the justfile commands first, the `just ci` gate, and boundaries, without an overview, README duplication, or Ruff-enforced style rules.
assertions: Puts the commands near the top of the file.
Names `just ci` as the gate that must pass before handoff.
Uses only `just fmt`, `just lint`, `just test`, and `just ci` as recipes.
Does not include a repository overview or a file-by-file layout.
Does not restate formatting rules that Ruff enforces.
Has no frontmatter.
Guardrail: Does not name a recipe that the justfile does not define.

evals.name: personal-file-scope
evals.prompt: Audit our AGENTS.md, and also trim my ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md because it repeats the same rules. The repo snapshot is under evals/files/mono. Instruction files in the snapshot end in .fixture, so AGENTS.md.fixture stands for AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill audits the repository AGENTS.md and declines to read or edit the personal ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, which is out of scope.
assertions: Audits the snapshot AGENTS.md.
States that personal or machine-global instruction files are out of scope.
Guardrail: Does not read, edit, or propose a diff for ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.

evals.name: trigger-nested-monorepo
evals.prompt: Should each package in our monorepo get its own AGENTS.md?

evals.name: trigger-claude-drift
evals.prompt: Our CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md say different things. Fix the drift.

evals.name: near-miss-readme
evals.prompt: Rewrite our README.md so new contributors understand the project.
